# Lessons Log — v1.0-brownfield-backfill

## L-EDP1-019 — Closes lines must use structured IDs, not freeform prose

Category: process
Date: 2026-04-08

Lesson: freeform prose in a Closes line (e.g., `**Closes:** fixed the thing`) is forbidden
per D-419(c). Only structured ID tokens are valid cite targets.

**Closes:** fixed the thing
